behaviors.description: A walkable Zen monastery and raked gravel garden stand west of the residential lane. F picks up/returns the altar lighter; hold F while aiming at incense for two seconds to ignite it. One 14 cm stick consumes over 1800 real elapsed seconds, leaves ash, then stops emitting smoke after five seconds. F replaces a spent stick. Ignition may be interrupted; a lit stick keeps burning during absence, pause and embedded DAW use. The session ends on Close. Smoke is a bounded analytic visual approximation, not fluid or combustion chemistry simulation. Small props are packed relative to the camera; smoke uses soft translucent coverage and is sorted from far to near against scene depth.
behaviors.selection: Normal Wormwood overworld with the monastery configured. Interactions are blocked by menus and held tools.

checks.expectation: Proximity and occlusion gate interaction, ignition requires a sustained hold, stick length halves at 15 minutes, ash remains at 30 minutes, smoke dissipates, no held-key repeat or duplicate event, Close cancels ownership. Monastery doors and path support walking within scene budgets.
checks.procedure: Run monastery focused tests, registered Host lifecycle and complete-town budget/contact tests; review native monastery exterior, garden, ignition, midpoint and spent-stick captures; playtest F interaction and pause/DAW return.
